name: Classic oscillating
notes: Wind model #10: 9-14 kn, oscillation +/-8 deg, no persistent trend; medium puffs, some lulls. #221 overrides #10's period of about 120 s with 70-90 s (#221 says about 75 s): a beat takes about 150-170 s, so the shift now swings through about two cycles a beat.
Units: knots, degrees, seconds, metres; gains, losses, shares, coverage and drift as fractions.

Version 2 (schema 2, #75) is version 1 plus the keyed wind's wobble: wobbleDegrees is the peak of the smaller, faster wobble (#10) each 30 s window's key draws on top of the oscillation, vanishing at the window's knots. Strength is fixed for the race (#10), so there is no strength-channel tuning.

Version 3 (#221, #233) is version 2 with only three values changed: the period 70-90 s (was 110-130 s), the wobble 3 deg (was 1 deg), readable but never outlasting its 30 s window, and the puff fan 9 deg (was 6 deg), about 1.5 x, so a puff can decide which tack is favoured. The amplitude and every other puff column are unchanged.

Placeholders (JSON Pointers above) await tuning on the #232 sliders: the 70-90 s period, the 3 deg wobble and the 9 deg fan (#221), and the other puff columns, set from #10's words (medium, some lulls) and its shared ranges (60-150 m, puffs +20-35 %, lulls -15-25 %, drift 0.3-0.5 x wind).

Version 4 (schema 3, #286, ADR 0008) is version 3 plus the pressure field: a pressure side (a slope in speed across the race area, up to strength at its sides, redrawn on average every persistenceSeconds, veering bendDegrees where it is stronger) and pressure lanes (count alive on average, each a band widthMetres wide along the wind with a peak gain of strength, living lifetimeSeconds, drifting sideways at up to driftMetresPerSecond and bending bendDegrees at its edges). Every other value is unchanged. The pressure field's values are placeholders awaiting the #232 sliders (#290 tunes them), set from #283's scale: about +/-15-25 % across the course, lanes a few hundred metres wide living 2-4 min.

Version 5 (schema 4, #287, ADR 0008) is version 4 plus how much the venue's geography steers the pressure field: side.tendencyScale, the range each race draws its multiplier on the venue's side tendency from (below 0 reversed, near 0 absent, above 1 stronger), and lanes.spotShare, the share of lanes that form at the venue's lane spots rather than anywhere across the course. Both are placeholders awaiting the #232 sliders: usually present, sometimes absent, occasionally reversed, and about 70 % of lanes at the spots. Every other value is unchanged.
